verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Workflow Builder, webhook triggers, branching, Deno SDK workflows written in TypeScript, the Slack CLI and developer sandboxes. None of it describes versioning, review/approval, or rollback of automations. Workflows-as-code could be tracked in a user's own git, but that is a user-side workaround, and sandboxes are a separate test environment, not rollback, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
